_comment: Project-level MCP servers for SC-500 Cert Buddy. These travel with the repo, so a clone is turnkey. mslearn is the free Microsoft Learn HTTP server (no key) that grounds all content. cert-buddy is the local FastMCP server in mcp-server/ that adds scoring, validation, progress, and quiz prompts. Create its virtual environment once so the local server can start: 'python3 -m venv mcp-server/.venv' then 'mcp-server/.venv/bin/pip install -r mcp-server/requirements.txt'. On Windows, use mcp-server\.venv\Scripts\python.exe as the command.
